mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate above 4.0% compresses equity valuations through higher discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of other conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 4.0% signals labor market tightness that accelerates corporate profit growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE < 4.0%, 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of cases, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 2 years.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand that accelerates corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When both HOUST and RSAFS exceed 3-month moving averages, 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of cases, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing slowdowns (INDPRO < 100) reduce industrial output and corporate earnings growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 100, 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of cases, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in real retail sales (RSAFS) above its 6-month moving average indicates strong consumer spending that supports corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When RSAFS exceeds 6-month moving average, 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of cases, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 2 years.

mechanism_narrative: Aggressive monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) prompts immediate equity market repricing through higher discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of cases, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 2 years.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment (UNRATE) and increases in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signal rapid labor market strengthening that boosts consumer confidence and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases, 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of cases, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: High housing demand (HOUST > 1300) triggers inflation concerns that prompt Fed policy tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST > 1300, 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of cases, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3 years.
